raw_sections.experience:
Lead Business Analyst & Product Owner | 13+ Years | BFSI · Capital Markets · Regulatory Reporting · AML/KYC 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner | Creospan (Client: Northern Trust) Aug 2025 – Apr 2026 Pune, India | MDM Integration · Client Onboarding · Trade Settlement
Owned product delivery for MDM integration with TCS BaNCS, defining product vision, feature roadmap, and release plan for client master data modernisation across 8+ global stakeholder groups.
Authored and prioritised user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria covering data mapping, XML publishing, batch processing, near real-time synchronisation, and exception management flows.
Supported Trade Settlement technology workstream, collaborating with the Northern Trust technology team to define data flow requirements, settlement instruction mapping, and exception handling logic aligned to post- trade processing standards.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — maintaining a healthy, prioritised product backlog aligned to delivery milestones.
Governed product risk through RAID log maintenance, vendor coordination, and milestone reporting, ensuring production readiness with zero post-launch critical defects.
Defined and enforced DoD standards across all sprint deliverables. • Collaborated with solution architects, developers, and QA teams to ensure product increments met defined acceptance criteria, integration standards, and non-functional requirements. • Conducted bi-weekly sprint review demos with 8 global business stakeholders.
Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner | IRIS Software (Client: Citi) Pune, India | RBI Regulatory Reporting Product — STP Transformation
Sep 2024 – Aug 2025
Acted as Product Owner for RBI EWS regulatory reporting platform, owning a backlog of 300+ user stories and driving prioritisation, refinement, and sprint planning for a 10+ member cross-functional delivery team.
Defined product vision, communicated strategic roadmap and release strategy for STP transformation, achieving 80% reduction in manual reporting effort and enabling direct system-to-regulator reporting to RBI channels.
Integrated product requirements across 10+ source systems, defining business rules, threshold logic, data validation frameworks, and error-handling protocols aligned to regulatory compliance mandates.
Managed product governance including BRD/FRD ownership, architecture coordination, DLQ design, UAT sign-off, budget planning support, and stakeholder alignment sessions with 8 global business owners.
Aligned product backlog priorities to OKRs/KPIs defined by business leadership. • Maintained consistent sprint velocity of 45+ story points across 12 sprints. • Managed 5 major product releases on schedule, with each release preceded by structured UAT cycles, release readiness reviews, and go-live checklists.
Senior Business Analyst (Product Focus) | BNY Mellon Jul 2022 – Sep 2024 Pune, India | Capital Markets · Product Data Management · Client Onboarding · Proxy Operations · Regulatory Reporting
Championed product data management transformation, designing and delivering Product Grid UI that eliminated Excel-based workflows and improved data accuracy by 60% for global product teams.
Defined product features, wireframe requirements, and user acceptance criteria for the Product Grid, working iteratively with UX and development teams through Agile sprint cycles.
Defined requirements for KYC client onboarding enhancements including document upload and verification flows and integration with AML/KYC screening tools, enabling process automation and measurable reduction in onboarding error rates for the KYC operations team.
Led CANE (Customer Account Number Expansion) — a firm-wide client onboarding infrastructure change impacting 15+ global applications, coordinating feature rollout across product and technology teams to improve account architecture scalability and client data integrity.
Defined requirements for the Proxy Enhancement Project — a new screen within the client onboarding application that digitised proxy service provider form submission to Broadridge, eliminating manual form- based communication. Designed an auto-population feature triggered by Proxy Edge ID selection, automatically populating provider name, address, contact, and email details for the top 2 proxy service providers (covering 80% of use cases), with manual entry retained for remaining 20% edge cases. Reduced pending case turnaround time by 2 business days, eliminating data entry errors and improving onboarding SLA adherence for global custody clients.
Owned regulatory product change delivery for CFTC, SDL, and ISDA initiatives, managing feature charters, regulatory playbooks, and user training aligned to compliance deadlines.
Incorporated VoC (Voice of Customer) insights from 3 regional teams into product backlog prioritisation. • Defined MVP scope for Phase 1 of the Proxy Enhancement Project.
Business Analyst | TCS Pune, India | Banking · AML · KYC · Financial Services
May 2015 – Jul 2022
Supported product and delivery teams across Banking and Financial Services programmes, managing requirements, feature documentation, and release coordination for AML, KYC, and client onboarding platforms.
Collaborated with Product Managers and business SMEs to translate strategic objectives into prioritised backlogs, user stories, and sprint-ready feature sets.
Facilitated UAT, defect management, and release sign-off activities, ensuring product increments met business acceptance criteria before go-live.
Managed end-to-end business analysis across multiple concurrent AML/KYC programmes, working with compliance, operations, and technology stakeholders to deliver regulatory-aligned solutions.
Produced BRDs, FRDs, process flow diagrams, and data mapping artefacts for banking and financial services platforms serving global client bases.
Process Associate | Gallagher Pune, India | Insurance Operations
May 2013 – May 2015
Supported insurance product operations, contributing to process accuracy, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency improvements through structured data processing and team coordination.
